31K likes, 306 comments - milindrunning on September 21, 2026: "Did it AGAIN !!!! Six days later one more Ironman 😁 Doing Ironman Wales on the 13th of September and Ironman Italy on 19th September was a great experience!!
This one was to learn new lessons on recovery, which is important to understand individual levels of fitness. One aspect of fitness is the time required to recover from a particular stress, to be able to do it again with the same level of comfort. A lot of interesting lessons 😀 What are your thoughts on recovery ?".

posts.meta_description: 62K likes, 918 comments - milindrunning on September 16, 2026: "And DONE !!! What is called the toughest full Ironman in the world, a rough swim, an 8000ft climb on the bike and a 2000ft climb on the run, on the 13th of September 2026, i have FACED THE DRAGON 😁 I’ve always been comfortable doing an Ironman, and that is the goal, but this one was hard, hard, hard 😀 what a wild, incredible route, rain the whole day, fantastic organisation, if there is one Ironman that must be done, this is it !!!!! As they say in Wales - Wynebu’r Ddraig !".

1,059 likes, 10 comments - milindrunning on October 12, 2026: "Walking into @cookeandkelvey1858 felt like stepping into over 150 years of horological heritage. From the moment I entered, the warmth, the knowledge and the sense of history made it more than a store
visit. It felt like an experience.

And it was here that I discovered the TUDOR Pelagos, a diving watch built for those who dare to go beyond the ordinary. Titanium construction, Ceramic bezel, Mechanical movement, great waterproofness. All backed
by the precision of Swiss watchmaking. Can't wait to checkout  the waterproofness on my next dive 😀

What made the visit even more meaningful was learning about Cooke & Kelvey's historic association with @tudorwatch dating back to the 1940s. A legacy where heritage meets a spirit of adventure.

Some places don't just sell watches. They hold stories. Thank you, Cooke & Kelvey, for an unforgettable experience.

#TUDOR #BornToDare #CookeAndKelvey #LuxuryWatches
#SwissWatchmaking".

390 likes, 14 comments - milindrunning on October 7, 2026: "On World Sight Day, I step into a reality that 1.1 billion people live with every single day. Blindfolded and guided through a simple room, I confronted what it means to lose the one sense we take most for granted.

90% of vision loss worldwide is preventable or treatable. Most people never receive the care they need, not because solutions don't exist, but because access never reached them in time.

For 30 years, Centre For Sight has been the name people trust with their vision. This World Sight Day, that trust extends to everyone who never had access to the care they deserved.

#WorldSightDay #CentreForSight #EyeCare #PreventBlindness #Vision".

posts.meta_description: 14K likes, 102 comments - milindrunning on September 22, 2026: "Yaaaaay!!! Finished another full Ironman together ❤️ We had planned to do Wales together as well, but Ankita’s fall from her bike on a steep descent during a practise session and subsequent injuries didn’t allow her to finish the tough course. Six days after Ironman Wales, she smashed her second Ironman again in Emilia Romagna, Italy! So so proud of your resilience, and how you picked yourself up and came back so strong my love 🤗 here’s to many more fun times together !! And yes...the Dragon will be waiting !!!!!".
